name: New Kothon Mobile App API
description:
## Overview
REST API documentation for New Kothon Mobile Application backend services provided by MC (MIME Communications).

## Authentication
The API uses two levels of authentication:
1. **Device Authentication**: All requests require `X-Device-Auth` header
2. **User Authentication**: Protected endpoints require JWT Bearer token in `Authorization` header

## Base URL
- Production: `https://gateway.mimebd.com`

## Common Response Codes
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 200 | Success |
| 201 | Created (for payment) |
| 400 | Bad Request - Invalid input |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Access denied |
| 404 | Not Found |
| 500 | Internal Server Error |
